messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — NovoMed just asked for an embeddings-retention exception addendum to the DPA. They want embeddings stored for 7 days (instead of our standard 24 hours) for automated quality checks. Can CS/Security/Legal confirm what evidence we need and an upload path so I can get their POE in one batch?

Priya Patel: Got it. What specifically should we collect? My initial thought: the addendum PDF, signed customer contact, the dataflow diagram showing ephemeral KV cache, S3 lifecycle rules, and the policy text for pseudonymization.

Marco Rivera: Security POV: 7 days is tolerable with controls. We need:
- confirmation embeddings are hashed/pseudonymized (if PII => no exception)
- S3 lifecycle policy enforcing 7 day auto-delete
- access logs showing only service accounts touched the objects
Also flagging SOC2 CC6.1 for data retention — Legal must approve.

Ella Thompson: Legal: I can prepare an addendum template. Need: customer legal name & email, scope text ("embeddings stored for 7 days for the purposes of model evaluation only"), and whether NovoMed considers embeddings as personal data. If they do, we won't approve. Once we have signed addendum + evidence bundle we can proceed.

Alex Chen: Customer PoC is Maya Lin (maya@novomed.com). They claim embeddings are "non-PII derived vectors" but will send a redacted sample. I'll request the signed addendum and the sample by EOD Friday.

Priya Patel: I'll make a single checklist and a single upload destination to avoid scatter. Proposed uploads:
```
/evidence/novomed/dpa-addendum/
  - signed_addendum.pdf
  - redacted_embeddings_sample.ndjson
  - s3_lifecycle_policy.json
  - access_log_snippet.txt
  - dataflow_diagram.pdf
```
Can someone confirm we can share that path with CS Ops for the batch?

Marco Rivera: Confirmed — security approves that path as long as the bucket is private and the lifecycle policy is present in the bundle. We'll want a short script extract of the IAM principals that accessed the sample (<=10 lines is fine).

Ella Thompson: OK I'll draft the addendum and put the draft in the thread in an hour. After customer signs, upload signed PDF to the path above. Legal will require the signed PDF before motioning to change retention config.

upload-bot: Reminder set — upload deadline: 2027-03-28 09:00 UTC. Use `/upload-batch` to notify Ops once files are in place.

Alex Chen: Perfect. I'll ping Maya for the signed doc and ask for the redacted sample. Will update here when it's in the folder. :thumbsup:

Priya Patel: I'll create the checklist and an issue in our onboarding tracker so Renewal/AMs see this exception. Tagging @Marco for later verification step.

Marco Rivera: Sounds good. If customer supplies sample early we can run a quick entropy check to verify non-PII claims. Share results here.

Ella Thompson: Note — if anything in the sample identifies a natural person, we stop and revert to standard 24 hrs.

Alex Chen: Understood. I'll aim to get the signed addendum + sample uploaded by Friday and will use `/upload-batch` once done. Thanks all.
thread_text_summary: NovoMed requested a 7-day embeddings retention exception. CS/Security/Legal discussed required evidence: signed addendum, redacted sample, S3 lifecycle policy, access logs, dataflow diagram. Legal will draft addendum; Security requires pseudonymization confirmation and lifecycle policy; upload-bot reminder set. CS to collect and upload to /evidence/novomed/dpa-addendum/ by deadline.
